answer: Because the timing is published against the marble challenge, the ivory audit can replay the quill history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 246 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2529 identities would post 1322 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
